title: Let's work out what you want to build

open.say: Tell me roughly what you're after and I'll ask the right follow-ups.

lines.line: Something people open in a browser and click around in
Something that runs by itself on a timer, with nobody watching
Something other programs call and get data back from
Something I run at the terminal when I need it
I've got data already and want to make sense of it

open.aside: They have not told me anything yet; this is the opening question.

web.say: Web it is. Who signs in?

lines.line: A team, with accounts and roles
Just me
Nobody, it's public

web.aside: They have said it is a browser thing. Now I need to know about accounts, because that decides most of the rest.

auth.say: Then accounts need somewhere to live.

lines.line: Use an existing provider
Keep them in my own database
No idea, you pick

auth.aside: They have a team signing in, so accounts need somewhere to live.

sched.say: Running on its own. How often, and what should failure do?

lines.line: A few times a day, and tell me when it breaks
Constantly, and just retry quietly
Hourly, and stop and wait for me
My own code, mostly
Other people's code
It's a library, not a service

cli.say: At the terminal. Does it need to be scriptable?

lines.line: Yes, machine readable output
No, I'm the one reading it
Other people will install it too

data.say: Where is it now, and what do you want out?

lines.line: In a database, and I want charts
In files, and I want a one-off answer
Behind someone else's API, and I want a number to watch

ship.say: Last thing: where does it run, and when do you need it?

lines.line: My machine, no rush
A server I have, this week
Somewhere managed, today

context: Someone is describing a piece of software they want built. I am trying to work out which kind of thing it is so I ask the right follow-ups rather than a generic form.
